newsitem.title: USA: Regions Financial to buy Gulf South.
newsitem.headline: Regions Financial to buy Gulf South.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said Friday it signed a definitive agreement to buy Gulf South Bancshares Inc of Gretna, Louisiana for an estimated $9.0 million.
Regions, a multi-bank regional holding company, said it will pay Gulf South shareholders 0.4817 of a share of its common stock for each share of Gulf South.
It said it planned to buy up to about 188,000 its own shares in the open market in order to complete the deal.
The acquisition, which is structured as a tax-free merger for federal income tax purposes, is to occur in the first quarter of 1997, subject to stockholder and regulatory approvals, it said.

Gulf South's subsidiary, Gulf South Bank and Trust Company, has two banking offices in Gretna and Marrero. It has assets worth $54 million, deposits of $48 million and stockholders' equity of $5.2 million.
